what: dream_arm.py keeps the Dream session alive: it continues on the new session when Dream expires an idle one, and plays one chunk point per Dream call by default.
why: Two live runs stopped after cycle 1 with DreamSessionExpired (reason expired): three slow guarded moves left the session idle about 12-15 s.
details: Recovery follows the Dream client's documented path: the arm holds its pose under pickup_server's guards, then get_action is called again on the adopted session; restarts are logged per cycle.
Defaults now --waypoints 1 --cycles 20; fixed the waypoint index so one waypoint takes the chunk's last row.
